name: Harness Config Writer
description: Deploys harness-native file/env config for configured local-provider harnesses (codex+opencode config files; claude/gemini/droid/qwen/kimi/kiro/iflow harness-env) on plugin load, writing ALL available models (auto-matched from the gateway's models.providers by baseUrl; required 'model' stays the default). Additive to bundled acpx: absence of a harness id writes NOTHING — vendor auth runs unchanged.

harnesses.description: Normalized per-harness config. The plugin generates the harness-native file/env config for ONLY the harnesses listed here (codex+opencode: config files for OpenAI-compatible local backends; claude/gemini/droid/qwen/kimi/kiro/iflow: harness-env/<id>.env sourced by the plugins.entries.acpx.config.agents.<id>.command/args override). ABSENCE of a harness id (or this whole section) = plugin writes NOTHING for it: native subscriptions (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, Copilot-OAuth) run unchanged via bundled acpx vendor auth. Changes apply on next boot.

model.description: Required, non-empty: the model id to claim for this harness.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible backend base URL (Ollama/vLLM/LocalAI/llama.cpp). Required for codex/opencode (file mechanism); appended with /v1 exactly once where the CLI expects it.

apiKey.description: API key/token the harness backend expects (auth.json OPENAI_API_KEY for codex, apiKey option for opencode, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN/KIRO_API_KEY/... for env harnesses). Placeholder 'ollama' when omitted.

thinking.description: Codex only: model_reasoning_effort written when non-empty.

models.description: Optional: available model ids for this harness (beyond the required 'model', which stays the default). Precedence: an explicit non-empty list WINS over auto-matching the gateway's models.providers by baseUrl; an explicit EMPTY list opts out entirely; when absent the writer auto-matches ALL model ids of the provider whose baseUrl matches this entry (deduped, capped at 200, fail-soft). Surfaces: opencode provider.models map; codex [profiles."<id>"] (not inherited by acpx sessions — direct codex-CLI users only); claude CLAUDE_MODEL_CONFIG JSON; other env harnesses get an informational comment.
